summary_en: Kamgras 1 LLC increased the tender offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. from 3,682 yen to 3,683 yen per share and extended the offer period by 10 business days to November 12, 2026, totaling 125 business days.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Tender Offer Terms for Kakaku.com Inc. (Securities Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 LLC
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Kamgras 1 LLC announced an amendment to the tender offer for Kakaku.com Inc. that commenced on May 13, 2026. The offer price per common share was increased from 3,682 yen to 3,683 yen. The tender offer period was extended by 10 business days, now concluding on November 12, 2026, for a cumulative total of 125 business days.

The adjustment was made in response to ongoing uncertainty and instability affecting Kakaku.com shareholders and warrant holders. As of September 29, 2026, the market price of Kakaku.com shares had exceeded the tender offer price. The disclosure documents indicate that a competing bidder (referred to as "本提案者") has announced a lower offer price of 3,597 yen, which falls below the threshold required for Kakaku.com's board to recommend the tender offer to shareholders under the acquisition agreement signed on May 12, 2026. The competing bidder had announced its proposed offer but has not commenced the tender offer, leaving the situation unresolved.
